gloss: defaulting on a debt; skipping out on a bill

definitions.gloss: defaulting on a debt; non-payment; skipping out on a bill
definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately failing to pay a debt, loan, or bill. Implies intentional avoidance of payment rather than inability to pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Defaulting on a debt is a crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲食代|いんしょくだい}→飲食代：29657_inshokudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}しで⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: He was caught skipping out on a restaurant bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{大家|おおや}さん→大家さん：26895_ooyasan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: Because rent non-payment continued, the landlord filed a lawsuit.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb ⟦{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}す→踏み倒す：06383_fumitaosu⟧ (to default on, to skip out on). The noun form refers to the act itself. Carries a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate dishonesty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し (defaulting on a debt)
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し (rent non-payment)
- {踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to default, to skip out on payment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未払|みはら}い: non-payment, unpaid (more neutral, may be unintentional)
- ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧: delinquency, arrears (formal administrative term)
- ⟦{食|く}い{逃|に}げ→食い逃げ：10929_kuinige⟧: dine and dash (specific to restaurants)
